title: dotJS 2012 - Fat - What Is Open Source & Why Do I Feel So Guilty?
summary: A dotJS 2012 conference talk by Fat (of Twitter Bootstrap fame) on what open source really means and why maintainers feel guilty about it. It covers the obligations, expectations and burnout that come with releasing popular open source software, delivered with humor.
why: HN commenters cite it as a funny and candid first-hand account of the guilt and burnout of a prolific open source developer.

quote.text: Maybe relevant to watch this video for a first hand report of burnout from a coding rockstar
